name: Busybodies
overview: Scripture warns against the destructive behavior of busybodies who spread harmful words and meddle in others' affairs. Leviticus 19:16 forbids acting as a talebearer, while Proverbs highlights how such words wound deeply and provoke strife. The heart behind busybody actions is often one that plans destruction and mischief, contrasting with the sincere devotion God desires, as Mark 7:6 reveals. Instead, believers are called to follow God faithfully, avoiding foolish interference and honoring Him with genuine hearts.
